mapper.select: SELECT DATE(IF(TIME(create_time) < '14:00:00', create_time - INTERVAL 1 DAY, create_time)) AS date, COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) AS revenue FROM booking WHERE create_time >= #{from} AND create_time < #{to} GROUP BY DATE(IF(TIME(create_time) < '14:00:00', create_time - INTERVAL 1 DAY, create_time)) ORDER BY date
